agent.f.protect.adminOnly: Owners and administrators set up the protection functions.
agent.f.protect.g.notWatching: The guard is not watching right now: {error}
agent.f.protect.g.watching: The guard watches the shares on all mounted volumes.
agent.f.protect.g.starting: The guard starts with the next round (within a minute).
agent.f.protect.g.what.unknown-extension: {when} {count} files were renamed to unknown extensions ({ext})
agent.f.protect.g.what.rewrite: {when} {count} files were rewritten with content that looks encrypted
agent.f.protect.g.what.notes: {when} ransom notes appeared in several folders ({count} files)
agent.f.protect.g.didSnap: I set the share to read-only, cut the device off and held the snapshot from {time}.
agent.f.protect.g.didLock: I set the share to read-only and cut the device off. There is no snapshot from before.
agent.f.protect.g.didRestore: {count} files are restored, {bin} changed files are in the share's recycle bin.
agent.f.protect.g.onlyTold: Reported only: the share stays writable (setting “Report only”).
agent.f.protect.g.notListed: {count} more are not listed one by one
agent.f.protect.g.restoreSub: {count} files; the changed files go to the recycle bin
agent.f.protect.g.noBtrfs: Without Btrfs there is no snapshot. Btrfs snapshots protect better.
agent.f.protect.g.noSnapshot: There is no snapshot from before the incident.
agent.f.protect.g.reopenSub: Only once the device is clean
agent.f.protect.g.wantedSub: e.g. your own encryption; open the share, restore nothing
agent.f.protect.g.confirmText.restore: The {count} affected files in “{share}” come back from the snapshot. What is there now goes to the share's recycle bin. The share stays read-only until you open it.
agent.f.protect.g.confirmText.reopen: Everyone gets their previous rights on “{share}” back. If the device is still infected, it can go on encrypting.
agent.f.protect.g.confirmText.dismiss: “{share}” is opened again and nothing is restored. The share raises no alarm for an hour.
agent.f.protect.h.rowSub: Build of the NAS and “What to do when …”
agent.f.protect.h.nightly: Made again at night when something changed.
agent.f.protect.e.rowSub: Request with {days} days of waiting time
agent.f.protect.e.without: Without an answer the access opens on {when}: read-only on
agent.f.protect.e.grantConfirm: {name} gets read access to {shares} and the emergency handbook at once, for 30 days.
agent.f.protect.e.noPersons: Nobody registered yet. Add persons in the settings below.
agent.f.protect.e.footer: Every access is in the activity log. The access ends by itself after 30 days.
agent.f.protect.e.notRegistered: You are not registered for the emergency access.
agent.f.protect.e.mineWaitingText: If nobody declines, the access opens on {when}.
agent.f.protect.e.mineGrantedText: You can read {shares} until {until} (Files or the Windows share).
agent.f.protect.e.explain: In an emergency you can request read access to {shares} and the emergency handbook here. The owners are told at once and may decline; without an answer you get access after {days} days.
agent.f.protect.e.codeLabel: One-time code (if you have a printed one)
agent.f.protect.e.codeText: Print it and keep it safe. With this code the emergency access opens without waiting. It works once and is shown only now.
agent.f.protect.s.title: Settings
agent.f.protect.s.modeHint.report: Tell owners and administrators; the share stays writable.
agent.f.protect.s.modeHint.lock: Share read-only, device cut off, snapshot held; restore after you confirm.
agent.f.protect.s.modeHint.auto: Like “Lock and report”, and restore by itself once it stops.
agent.f.protect.s.quiet: Quiet seconds until it counts as stopped
agent.f.protect.s.pre: Hourly snapshot to go back to (Btrfs)
agent.f.protect.s.preHint: Only while data is written anyway, kept two days; wakes no disk.
agent.f.protect.s.excludeHint: e.g. a share that receives encrypted backups
agent.f.protect.s.probesHint: From the monthly probes of the backups
agent.f.protect.s.contactsHint: Your own entries, e.g. who helps in an emergency
agent.f.protect.s.codeHint: Grants without waiting; one printable code per person
agent.f.protect.s.readOnly: The emergency access never gives write access and never more than the person has; when it ends it takes back exactly what it gave.
